summary: Iteration 3 (Bulk Contract Review) end-to-end tested. All 7 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend E2E via Playwright confirms sidebar link, dashboard route, dropzone, queue mgmt (add/remove/clear/reject unsupported), run button enable/disable + dynamic label, full bulk POST -> stats strip, callouts, league table with sort dropdown & expandable rows. Risky NDA scored 98 (high), safe NDA scored 45 — matches spec (riskiest >=70 high, safest <60). Regression on single /api/review/contract/upload passes. /api/modules includes bulk-contracts + layers icon.

issues: At 0 files the button label reads 'Review  contracts' (double space, no count). Consider hiding the count entirely or showing 'Review contracts' when files.length === 0. Cosmetic only — button is disabled anyway.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Fix double-space in 'Review  contracts' label when files.length === 0 in BulkContractPage.jsx line 195.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py bulk endpoint reads full file content into memory (up to 20 x 15MB = 300MB potential). Fine for MVP but consider streaming or per-file size check before read for safety.
server.py line 951 defines _return_value AFTER first use at line 897 — works due to Python late-binding but is misleading. Move helper above call site.
BulkContractPage.jsx is 442 lines including 3 subcomponents; acceptable but could be split when it grows.
No client-side validation of duplicate filename+size collisions in queue (already handled via Set on name+size). OK.
The 'Sort by name' visual test happened to be a no-op because alphabetically 'ui_risky' < 'ui_safe' also matches risk_desc order in this test. Sort logic itself verified by code review — correct.
test_credentials: Fresh users registered per run via /api/auth/register (uitest<ts>@nyaya.in / pass1234).
seed_data_creation: None. Test users and batches created transiently; DOCX fixtures generated in-memory via python-docx.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 (Bulk Contracts) fully green. Regression path: run pytest -n 0 /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py (xdist parallel workers previously caused email collisions — the file now uses uuid suffix). Frontend auth: register via fetch, drop token into localStorage keys 'nm_token' + 'nm_user', then navigate to /app/bulk-contracts. Bulk POST takes ~15-20s for 2 small text files.
